body: The Gaming Crib It is a cross-play Minecraft server that anyone can play bedrock or java, in versions from 1.7-newest on Java and on Bedrock the newest version, and is not pay to win, there are multiple worlds that you can play in (if you ask the owner on discord (me) he will make a private world for you and whoever you want to invite ;), we have got data packs that change the world terrain and makes custom structures which some have insane loot or they look cool or both!! we even have rewards for voting!!!
